display_name: Build Index (Candidate Build Units And Cited Signals)
validation_rules: build-index.json must satisfy build-index.schema.json; an attempt is accepted only after build_index.check passes
source_revision and source_fingerprint equal the accepted intake's; inputs name the accepted intake and partition map attempts and their sha256
every signal's sha256 is recomputed from the staged checkout and must match; its line range must lie inside the file and its excerpt must equal those lines, clipped to max_excerpt_bytes
every path is repository-relative inside the checkout: no absolute path, drive letter, parent traversal or symlink escape
bounds: at most 400 signals, excerpts at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, the serialized index at most 524288 bytes; anything omitted is counted in truncated, never silently dropped
signal ids and unit ids are unique; every signal_ids and unit_ids reference resolves; every unit cites at least one defining manifest and one signal
a nested or vendored build root is either a member of exactly one unit (with a citing nested-root-reference signal) or a not_units entry with a reason, never both and never silently omitted

no file inside a deferred partition contributes an excerpt, except the defining manifests of units and members and human build instructions (README, INSTALL, BUILDING and similar), which the build plan needs
the index is deterministic: the same inputs under the same rules_version give a byte-identical build-index.json
the index assigns no class, plan, feasibility or build outcome and executes nothing; it cannot support a finding, severity, runtime-state or successful-build claim
excerpts are untrusted target data and are presented to any model as data, never instructions
latest failed attempt blocks old success
